note: Views Show More Pager provides one Views pager plugin, 'show_more' (Show more pager), selectable in a view's Pager section. Options (schema views.pager.show_more): show_more_text (button label, default 'Show more'), result_display_method (append | html=Replace), initial (first-page item count; 0 = same as items_per_page), items_per_page (per-click batch), plus effects (animation) and advance (selectors, default content .view-content / pager .pager-show-more). Settings live in the view display's pager options. Works AJAX and non-AJAX (built for AJAX; JS lib + response subscriber). No config/routes/permissions/Drush; requires core views. Medium cases create a namespaced view whose show_more pager has a distinctive initial / show_more_text and read it back. Hard cases switch a view's pager to show_more / set the initial first-page count, verified against the live view config; reset creates the view with a core pager (or initial 0) so verify fails on empty state.

evals.prompt: What does the Views Show More Pager module add to Views, and what is the pager plugin's machine id?
evals.expected_output: It adds a Views pager plugin with id 'show_more' ('Show more pager') — a load-more button that fetches the next batch of results instead of numbered pages, selectable in a view's Pager section.

evals.prompt: The Views Show More pager has a 'result display method' option. What are the two choices and how do they differ?
evals.expected_output: Append (result_display_method 'append') adds the next batch after the existing rows (a true load-more in AJAX mode; page refresh in non-AJAX); Replace ('html') swaps the content with the next batch in both modes.

evals.prompt: In the Views Show More pager, what does the 'Initial items' setting do, and what does a value of 0 mean?
evals.expected_output: 'Initial' sets how many items appear on the first page; each 'Show more' click then loads 'items per page' more. 0 means use the same count as items-per-page for the first page too.

evals.prompt: The view 'vsm_eval' on this site uses the Show more pager. Inspect its configuration and tell me how many items it shows on the first page.
evals.expected_output: 12 items initially: views.view.vsm_eval default display -> display_options.pager.options.initial = 12 (then items_per_page per Show more click).

evals.prompt: Inspect the view 'vsm_eval_text' on this site (which uses the Show more pager) and tell me the exact label configured on its show-more button.
evals.expected_output: The button label is 'Load more articles': pager.options.show_more_text = 'Load more articles'.

evals.prompt: The view 'vsm_eval_task' currently uses the default full (numbered) pager. Change its default display to use the Views Show More 'Show more pager' instead. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vsm_eval_task default display uses pager type 'show_more'. Set the display's pager plugin to show_more and save the view.

evals.prompt: The view 'vsm_eval_initial' already uses the Show more pager, but its initial first-page item count is 0 (same as per-click). Configure it to show 10 items on the first page. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: views.view.vsm_eval_initial default display pager (type show_more) has options.initial = 10. Set the pager's 'Initial items' to 10 and save the view.
